steps.content: You feel yourself fall.
It's as if someone is guiding you from behind, pushing you into the endless silence.
For some reason, before you completely lose consciousness, the indecipherable prophecy emerges from the depths of your memory.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Ahead of you, the raging gale brings destruction and the mighty earth trembles without end. The ends of the world shall be shaken, and so shall the abyss.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: And you... ignorance shall bring about your fall and fear shall bring about your collapse. You shall be taken away from your past to face the chaos of the unknown.

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: But there is no need to turn back. There is someone ahead to tread the path for you; someone to block the gale for you. As long as you march on, you have a chance to reach the true...

steps.speaker: Stargazer
steps.content: Go on... someone ahead will light up the stars for you and take you back to where you truly belong...
Did the mysterious Stargazer also foresee everything that is happening?
Darkness envelops everything around you... Your consciousness surges as if a vortex has spun it a million times. The overwhelming nausea forces you awake.
You have no idea how long you've been swallowed by the Tide of Ashes. Space and time seem to have lost their meaning in this manic realm.
You try to call out for Hecate and Hella, but the sounds from your mouth are torn to pieces... Then they twist and reorganize into bizarre syllables.
(Rustling...)
In the midst of the gray haze, something is moving. It seems to be invisible and intangible, but it definitely is there.
(Rustling...)
It, no, they, are slowly moving and stopping. Wherever they pass, they leave behind their horrifying sound and presence.

Yet you can't see their true faces. No matter how much you concentrate, only hazy black shadows appear before your eyes. So you simply stand among them quietly, like an outsider that doesn't fit in, but also like something to be swallowed and assimilated.
You remember the terrifying figure mentioned by Kawa-kawa... the Apostle of Ashes.
Nearby, the storm rages on, yet you are caught in the eye of dead silence and isolation, facing these nebulous but deadly... apostles.
It's fine, you reassure yourself... Though your mind is tense, you know that your link with Hecate has not been broken. At least... they are still alive, and perhaps... you are also still alive, too.
(Rustling...)

Amidst the dead silence, even your breathing becomes tense and cautious. You want to concentrate and figure out a way to escape, but somehow, as if caught in a magnetic field, your thoughts slowly lapse...
...Chief... (Rustling...)
A subtle sound different from the constant rustling breaks through the dead silence.
The huge black shadows surrounding you seem to sense something and turn in unison towards the sound!

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Is... is that...?!
Alarm bells are going off in your head! Hecate and the others must have found help, but the rescue crew is surely doomed!

The black shadows around you laugh shrilly. By the time you react, a fleet of ships in your vision has been swallowed up by the black shadows. You hear bloodcurdling shrieks and wails, distorted by the sandstorm.
Yet the ships at the back haven't stopped, still cruising at normal speed towards your direction.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: Stay away!
Roarrrr!!

Howls echo from a lifeboat near you, and several Manic rescue crew members jump out from it. Their eyes are pitch-black, as if walking corpses with their souls drained from them. They run wildly towards you.

<size=50>Run!</size> 
Your mind is preoccupied with this one thought, and your body starts to instinctively run away.

steps.speaker: Corruptor in WhiteSands
steps.content: <size=50>Roarrrr...!! Roarrrr!!</size>

The wind begins to lash about wildly in the disrupted silent zone, trying to push you back to the deadly realm. The desert sand wraps around your fleeing feet like quicksand, engulfing your body bit by bit. "It" wants to keep you in the Tide of Ashes forever.

steps.speaker: Chief
steps.content: I will not... and cannot, die here!
I never said you'd die here...
Bzzz bzzz... the roar of an engine rings in your ears as someone pulls you forcefully by the collar and yanks you out of the quicksand.

The rescue crew members who had been swallowed up and transformed into Corruptors all seem to sense the quicksand. They bypass the area and lunge towards you, their faces snarling and their bodies twisting wildly.
